correctness.rationale: A constant Itô solution requires zero diffusion. The printed diffusion vector is \(\sigma(x,y,z)^{\mathsf T}\), so for \(\sigma>0\) only the origin can be a point equilibrium. On the invariant face \(Y=Z=0\), the enterprise-A equation is exactly geometric Brownian motion, whose lognormal law has positive upper tail beyond 1 at every positive time from every interior \(x_0\). The source parameters give deterministic drift \(3.8\) at the alleged all-join corner after the factor \(1-x\) is deleted. All statements are reconstructed directly from the printed equations; finite computation is used only for arithmetic replay.

value.rationale: The defect changes the mathematical object being modeled: variables presented as probabilities can leave the probability cube, and the central all-join state is not a stochastic equilibrium. This invalidates the interpretation of the paper's stochastic stability section and prevents its numerical coalition conclusions from being attributed to equations (3.4)–(3.6) without an additional projection or a rederived boundary-preserving SDE. The exact geometric-Brownian reduction supplies a quantitative, reproducible obstruction rather than a purely formal notation criticism.
